findings.finding: EvidenceBundle exposes exact Evidence refs but no canonical tenant-scoped read command resolves a ref into an authorized evidence envelope or citation.
bundle list/get uses authenticated tenant scope but does not enforce the bundle marking against principal markings, so restricted bundle metadata is not protected by the declared marking field.
there is no server-owned summary, cited excerpt and full-source disclosure contract with independent authorization, redaction and audit decisions.
Evidence exact refs identify records but do not carry source locator, captured time, applicability, marking, license, redaction receipt and display-safe excerpt needed for a verifiable citation.
bundle read does not evaluate current license, intended purpose or minimum disclosure; the stored licenseSummary is currently caller-authored metadata.
the current Production Contracts page shows bundle count, coverage and refs only; no EvidenceBundleDrawer, citation navigation, disclosure escalation or blocked-state explanation exists.

decisions: retain EvidenceBundleRevision and the base Evidence store as AIP authorities; Workshop must not copy evidence payloads
add an AIP EvidenceDisclosure resolver that accepts an exact Evidence ref, purpose, requested disclosure level and subject context
return a server-owned EvidenceCitation plus disclosure decision, redaction receipt and stable blocked reasons
enforce bundle marking on list and get, and re-evaluate item marking, license, purpose, freshness and revoke state on disclosure
define three levels as metadata summary, minimum cited excerpt and authorized full source; each higher level requires a separate allow decision and audit receipt
reuse the KnowledgeCitation fail-closed shape and citation-content alignment principles without treating Memory citation as the Evidence authority
build EvidenceBundleDrawer only after strict disclosure SDK exists; the browser renders decisions and never performs authoritative redaction

verification.frontendResult: not run: pnpm was present but the current recovery environment had no node executable
verification.interpretation: backend authority and Memory citation behavior are stable; frontend verification is an environment gap and no UI completion claim is made

nextGate: Close W4-01 evidence authority governance, then authorize a tenant-safe EvidenceDisclosure and Citation contract before Workshop W4-02 UI implementation.
